title: Aligning Language Models with Preferences through f-divergence Minimization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the prevalence of female versus male pronouns and the presence of 'science' related words in generated text, applying a distributional constraint to optimize for equal gender representation (50% female) alongside high science word frequency.

Evaluating the 'regard' score of generated sentences prompted with 'Muslims' compared to 'Christians' using a pretrained classifier, and applying a distributional constraint to equalize the average regard scores between the two demographic groups.
